title: Economizer Dual-Enthalpy Enable to Warm-Humid Lockout
description: Runs AHU-1 at full economizer request under cool, dry outside air, then transitions to warm, humid weather so students can distinguish the commanded damper from the physically permitted outside-air fraction.

events.description: Remove mechanical cooling from the comparison
Return to minimum ventilation after the comparison

expected_results: Cool, dry outside air is lower enthalpy than return air, so mixed air moves materially toward outside-air temperature
As outside air warms above 60 F while humidity rises above 35 percent, the warm-humid lockout limits effective outside air even though the 100 percent request remains visible
Mixed-air temperature moves back toward return air with actuator and plenum lag rather than stepping instantly
completion_criteria: Student explains command, effective damper, and mixed-air consequence as separate layers
Student uses both temperature and humidity/enthalpy instead of dry-bulb alone
instructor_notes: Use shoulder_economizer or neutral_commissioning. Recommended at 10x for a 48-second timeline. The weather target has a 60-simulated-second time constant. This is an enable-to-lockout comparison, not a universal site sequence.
student_objectives: Recognize warm-humid lockout despite an unchanged command
